name: Onachuu!
source:
One day, Naho, Hajime's classmate, suddenly asks him how to masturbate...

Though he hasn't had sex yet, he, who's got lots of a little bit wrong knowledge about it through internet and Eroge, decides to teach her how...

[From ErogeShop]
